tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search or browse Helve's broad catalog of third-party tools (LLMs, embeddings, web search, extraction, site mapping, deep research, TTS/audio, SEC filings, GitHub, arXiv, academic papers, weather, geocoding, DNS, FX, package registries). Omit `query` (or pass `category` alone) to browse live tools w

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Browse Helve's live tool catalog by category without guessing a search keyword. Returns every category, its live tool count, and sample tool IDs.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Check your Helve account USD credit balance, 30-day call & spend usage summary, and the active API key's spend_limit_usd budget cap.

tools.name: call_tool
tools.description: Invoke any tool in Helve's catalog by tool_id with tool-specific arguments (discover tool_ids and schemas first via search_tools). Metered per call against your single Helve balance; failed upstream calls debit $0.

tools.name: request_tool
tools.description: Log a third-party tool or API you need that is not yet in Helve's catalog. Helve tracks agent demand and prioritizes integrations where agents are blocked.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the live web. One call searches across Helve's providers (Exa, Parallel, Tavily, Brave, Serper, Firecrawl, Linkup, Valyu, Jina) and returns titles, URLs, publication dates, and content snippets. provider "fusion" queries several engines in parallel and ranks by cross-engine consensus — use it

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Submit a prerecorded audio or video URL for durable batch transcription. Returns immediately with a job ID; use transcription_status to retrieve its state and completed result.

tools.name: transcription_status
tools.description: Get the current state of a durable transcription job. Includes the normalized transcript when complete.

tools.name: list_transcriptions
tools.description: List your recent durable audio transcription jobs and their statuses.

tools.name: cancel_transcription
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running durable transcription job owned by your account.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Extract clean, readable content from one or more web page URLs (articles, docs, listings). Pass query to pull only the sections relevant to a topic instead of the whole page. Content is markdown.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, transcribe, transcription_status · Private data: get_balance · Public sink: transcribe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, transcribe, transcription_status · Private data: get_balance · Public sink: transcribe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_tools" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
